description: Neutral notification policy of the Blank pack: the review, end-date and critical-notice reminders to the owners of a contract's category, and their acknowledgement. Data, not code: every event, recipient rule, template and reminder window here is editable configuration.

reminderReview.subject: Review due in {{days.remaining}} days: {{contract.reference}}
reminderReview.body: {{contract.reference}} ({{contract.title}}) is due for review on {{due.date}} ({{days.remaining}} days). Please acknowledge: {{link}}

reminderCritical.subject: Critical notice deadline in {{days.remaining}} days: {{contract.reference}}
reminderCritical.body: The notice deadline for {{contract.reference}} ({{contract.title}}) is {{due.date}} ({{days.remaining}} days). Please acknowledge: {{link}}
